# Capability matrix

<!-- Generated by tools/verify_docs.py from docs/catalog/capabilities.json. -->

Status meanings are defined in [Evidence levels](evidence-levels.md). This table records
the strongest evidence for the exact listed scenario, not a blanket protocol certification.

## Modbus TCP

[Protocol guide](../protocols/modbus/index.md)

| Capability | Evidence status | Evidence summary |
|---|---|---|
| Bit and register read/write | `independently-verified` | libmodbus and PyModbus 3.12.0 server/client cross-check; ModbusPal simulator FC01/02/03/05/06/0F/10 with independent read-back (FC04 UNAVAILABLE in ModbusPal); software-qualification lab 2026-10-20 (lab/): PyModbus 3.12.0 server and proconX diagslave 3.6 three-client differential (Proxus, PyModbus, libmodbus 3.1.10) with zero divergences |
| Typed scalars, arrays, and compiled plans | `independently-verified` | PyModbus typed/service interop plus deterministic planner tests |
| Native AOT network execution | `native-aot-verified` | Combined Modbus/S7 published native network probe |
| Modbus RTU framing over TCP (serial gateway) | `independently-verified` | Software-qualification lab 2026-10-20 (lab/): PyModbus 3.12.0 server with RTU framer over TCP, two-client differential (Proxus, PyModbus RTU framer) with zero divergences, 9/9 fault runs, 30 min soak with zero violations and replay checks; specification CRC examples matched byte for byte; libmodbus UNAVAILABLE (no RTU-over-TCP backend) |
| Modbus RTU over a caller-supplied stream (serial port) | `deterministically-tested` | In-repository RTU fixture through a stream factory (reopen after failure, CRC and Unit ID faults); no serial port, RS-485 adapter or physical RTU device tested |
| Modbus RTU Native AOT execution | `native-aot-verified` | Published osx-arm64 Modbus probe ran RTU read, typed write/read-back and a CRC fault against the in-repository RTU fixture |
| Modbus ASCII framing over TCP (serial gateway): bit and register reads and writes, read-back by every client | `independently-verified` | Lab differential: Proxus, PyModbus 3.12.0 (ASCII framer) and proconX modpoll (ASCII on a socat pseudo-terminal) report identical values from a PyModbus ASCII server and from proconX diagslave 3.5 in ASCII mode, after each wrote its own registers and coils; zero divergences and zero oracle mismatches; libmodbus UNAVAILABLE (no ASCII backend) |
| Modbus ASCII request characters and response decoding | `deterministically-tested` | 20 golden vectors recorded from PyModbus 3.12.0 and proconX modpoll (identical frames) by tools/modbus_ascii_record_vectors.py: the driver sends the same characters and decodes the recorded PyModbus server responses to the values both masters decoded; the specification's :1103006B00037E example matched |
| Modbus ASCII recovery under network faults | `independently-verified` | Lab fault matrix through Toxiproxy against both ASCII servers: 18/18 PASS, and a 30-minute soak with zero violations in 33724 operations |
| Modbus ASCII over a caller-supplied stream, custom functions, lower-case responses, line noise, LRC, character and delimiter faults | `deterministically-tested` | In-repository ASCII fixture (11 self-tests, eight suites rerun over ASCII); no serial port, RS-485 adapter or physical ASCII device tested |
| Modbus ASCII Native AOT execution | `native-aot-verified` | Published osx-arm64 Modbus probe ran ASCII read, typed write/read-back, a custom function and an LRC fault against the in-repository ASCII fixture |
| Physical PLC write qualification | `blocked` | No authorized physical write matrix recorded |

## OPC UA

[Protocol guide](../protocols/opc-ua/index.md)

| Capability | Evidence status | Evidence summary |
|---|---|---|
| SecureChannel, Session, Read, and Browse | `vendor-and-independently-verified` | asyncua 2.0.1 (independent) and Prosys OPC UA Simulation Server 2026.1.0-16 (vendor simulator); software-qualification lab 2026-10-20 (lab/): open62541 v1.4.14 and OPC Foundation UA-.NETStandard 1.5.378.176 reference server read differential against asyncua 1.1.8 |
| Recovery after the server drops the Session | `independently-verified` | software-qualification lab session stage 2026-10-20 (lab/run.sh session): open62541 v1.4.14 (idle Session timeout and server-side UA_Server_closeSession) and UA-.NETStandard 1.5.378.176 (idle Session timeout), None/Anonymous and Basic256Sha256 SignAndEncrypt; the next Read or Write returned BadSessionIdInvalid as ReconnectAndRetry/Broken, IsSessionActive became false, and DisconnectAsync, ConnectAsync and a new Session restored correct reads; BadSessionClosed itself was not returned by either server and is covered by a deterministic fixture only |
| Session activated again on a new SecureChannel after the channel was lost (ReactivateSessionOnReconnect), unsecured and SignAndEncrypt/Basic256Sha256 | `independently-verified` | Lab session stage channel-loss-reactivate (lab/results/2026-10-23-opcua-session-reactivation): open62541 (Anonymous; UserName) and UA-.NETStandard (Anonymous) activate the same Session and serve correct reads, 4/4; fallback to CreateSession, orphaned subscription deletion and the opt-out covered by a self-test |
| Write | `independently-verified` | asyncua 2.0.1 with independent asyncua client read-back; not exercised against the Prosys vendor simulator; software-qualification lab 2026-10-20 (lab/): open62541 v1.4.14 and UA-.NETStandard 1.5.378.176 write/read-back differential against asyncua 1.1.8 |
| BrowseNext continuation | `independently-verified` | Prosys vendor simulator forced a one-reference page; the asyncua fixture issued no continuation point |
| Aes256_Sha256_RsaPss Sign and SignAndEncrypt | `vendor-and-independently-verified` | asyncua and Prosys vendor-simulator secure endpoint matrices |
| UserName and X509 identity tokens | `independently-verified` | asyncua Sign and SignAndEncrypt matrices; the Prosys vendor simulator exercised Anonymous only; software-qualification lab 2026-10-20 (lab/): UserName on open62541 v1.4.14 and UA-.NETStandard 1.5.378.176 (Basic256Sha256 Sign and SignAndEncrypt); X509 tokens not exercised there |
| X509 token signed under a token SecurityPolicy that differs from the channel policy | `deterministically-tested` | Signature and algorithm-URI regressions for a Basic256Sha256 token policy on an Aes256_Sha256_RsaPss endpoint; no independent or vendor Session advertised a differing token policy |
| Basic256Sha256 Sign and SignAndEncrypt | `independently-verified` | software-qualification lab 2026-10-20 (lab/): open62541 v1.4.14 (mbedTLS) and OPC Foundation UA-.NETStandard 1.5.378.176 reference server, SignAndEncrypt (Anonymous, UserName) and Sign (UserName) read/write differential against asyncua 1.1.8 with zero divergences; deterministic OPN/MSG round-trip, multi-block encryption, and tamper tests; no vendor simulator Session |
